prompt: Create a polished desktop web-app comp, a flat full-viewport webpage seen straight-on at 1440x980 (no browser frame, no device, no photograph, no poster). Product: Pak Hub, a public searchable library for Deep Rock Galactic .pak mods; use only synthetic example entries and make a small visible SAMPLE DATA label. Visitor task is to search, inspect a release history, choose a file variant, and download. Visual direction is fixed: a DRG-inspired industrial mine-operations terminal, coal-black slate ground, warm oxidized metal neutrals, precise amber hazard yellow and restrained mineral teal, fine hairline dividers, deliberate empty space, White Rabbit typeface for the logo and short terminal headings, clean readable humanist sans for all body text. No copied game logo or character, no gradients, glow, glass, stock art, or fake texture. The screen itself must be a working interface with standard web controls. Composition A: a compact masthead, then a three-column working manifest: narrow filter rail on left, wide searchable result list in center, selected mod release dossier at right. The list is the focal point and the right dossier is quiet. Make the brand Pak Hub legible; heading PAK MANIFEST; search field labelled SEARCH MODS; category filter list; rows have mod title, category, creator, latest version, release date; selected dossier has versions and two variants and a clear DOWNLOAD PAK button. Use fictional names such as Lantern Rangefinder and Cave Echo Calibrator, mark them as demo, no invented download counts or compatibility claims. High craft, clear contrast, actual usable product UI, not generic SaaS cards.
